answer:
The wrestler who has won the most Intercontinental championships is **Chris Jericho**, who holds the record with **9 total reigns**. 

In 2008, Chris Jericho won his **eighth Intercontinental Championship** by defeating Jeff Hardy. This title win occurred on **March 10, 2008**, during a special "WrestleMania Rewind" episode of Monday Night Raw. The match was held at **The Bradley Center in Milwaukee, Wisconsin**.
